question: Who makes Olivado avocado oil
markdown:
Olivado avocado oil is made by
the
Olivado Group
, a company founded in Kerikeri, New Zealand. They pioneered cold-pressed extra virgin avocado oil in 2000 and now produce it through facilities in New Zealand and via their subsidiary
Olivado EPZ Ltd
in Kenya, working with thousands of small local farmers.
Ocado
